# Research Staff and Students {.unnumbered #sec-getting-started-students}

## Eligibility {-}

Databrary policies, your home institution, and the professor who supervises your research determine whether you are eligible to be granted access to Databrary as a **Sponsored Researcher**. To be eligible as a Databrary Sponsored Researcher, you must meet these factors:

- I conduct research under the supervision of an Authorized Investigator's sponsorship or someone who is eligible to become an Authorized Investigator; 
- I am a student, research staff, or post-doctoral researcher.
- I have current training that addresses research ethics with human subjects (e.g.[CITI training](https://about.citiprogram.org/)).

## Seeking Authorization {-}

If these factors apply to you, must [register](https://databrary.org/user/register) for Databrary, request authorization from your research supervisor, and secure that person's authorization.

### 1. Register on Databrary

Registration involves creating an account using your institutional email, setting a password, and confirming your account.

### 2. Request Authorization From Your Research Supervisor

If your research supervisor is already a Databrary Authorized Investigator, that person will receive a request to add you to their list of sponsored researchers.

If your research supervisor is **not** a Databrary Authorized Investigator, they will need to register for Databrary, request authorization from their institution, and complete
The authorization process involves approval from an institutional official by means of formal signatures on the [Databrary Access Agreement](../appendices/access_agreement.qmd) and its Annexes.
